title: ProviderRunMetrics
description: Truthful aggregate metrics for one logical generic-provider search. Acquisition-volume fields are only acquisition_budget and acquisition_requested plus display_requested. Do not invent acquisition_limit. JSON Schema cannot prove displayed == min(usable, display_requested) or acquisition_requested <= acquisition_budget; application validation and golden-fixture tests enforce those invariants. fetched, mapped, and rejected stay null when unobservable. Never fabricate unknown stages as 0.

display_requested.description: User-visible maximum requested for that provider. Always known.

acquisition_budget.description: Finite aggregate ceiling approved by AcquisitionBudgetPolicy. Not work already requested.

acquisition_requested.description: Sum of candidate limits from internal acquisitions that actually executed. Unused budget is excluded.

fetched.description: Raw records received when truthfully observable; otherwise null.

mapped.description: Records converted into BERA's narrow safe model when observable; otherwise null.

rejected.description: Policy/mapping rejections when the stage boundary is truthful; otherwise null.

usable.description: Size of the ordered usable pool after integrity policy and identity-only dedup.

displayed.description: Must equal min(usable, display_requested). Canonical session membership uses this prefix.
